project.name: CPMForge.M365.Open
project.description: Coded activity library for Microsoft 365 automation. ImmutableID-first Graph mail and OneDrive/SharePoint operations.

activities.name: BuildIntakeEligibilityConfig
activities.summary: Assembles an IntakeEligibilityConfig from individual rule values. Pass the output to CheckMailMessageEligibility as EligibilityRules. Leave any rule at its default (0 / empty) to disable it.

sections.title: Inputs
sections.body:
- `SenderDomainWhitelist`: `List<string>` - Only allow messages from these domains (e.g. 'contoso.com'). Empty = rule inactive.
- `SenderEmailBlacklist`: `List<string>` - Reject messages from these exact addresses. Use "self" as an alias for the configured mailbox account (self-loop detection). Empty = rule inactive.
- `SenderEmailWhitelist`: `List<string>` - Only allow messages from these exact addresses. Empty = rule inactive.
- `SubjectMustContain`: `List<string>` - All listed terms must appear in the subject (case-insensitive). Empty = rule inactive.
- `SubjectMustNotMatch`: `string` - Regex pattern — reject if subject matches. Empty = rule inactive.
- `SubjectMaxLength`: `int` - Reject if subject exceeds this character count. 0 = rule inactive.
- `RequireAttachment`: `bool?` - True = message must have at least one attachment. False = must have none. Null/unset = rule inactive.
- `AllowedExtensions`: `List<string>` - Permitted attachment extensions without the dot (e.g. 'pdf', 'xlsx'). Empty = rule inactive.
- `MaxAttachmentSizeMb`: `int` - Reject any single attachment exceeding this size in megabytes. 0 = rule inactive.
- `MaxTotalAttachmentCount`: `int` - Reject if total number of attachments exceeds this count. 0 = rule inactive.
- `MaxAgeHours`: `int` - Reject messages older than this many hours. 0 = rule inactive.
- `BodyMustContain`: `List<string>` - All listed terms must appear in the body (case-insensitive). Empty = rule inactive.
- `BodyMustNotContain`: `List<string>` - Reject if any listed term appears in the body. Empty = rule inactive.

sections.title: Outputs
sections.body: - `Payload`: `IntakeEligibilityConfig` - Assembled IntakeEligibilityConfig. Pass directly to CheckMailMessageEligibility as EligibilityRules.

activities.name: CheckMailMessageEligibility
activities.summary: Evaluates system + business eligibility rules on a MailMessage. Mutates msg.SkipReason/IsTriaged and returns an EligibilityResult. No Graph calls.

sections.title: Inputs
sections.body:
- `Config`: `M365Config` - Optional. Used only to resolve the 'self' alias in SenderEmailBlacklist against Mail.MailboxAccount.
- `EligibilityRules`: `IntakeEligibilityConfig` - Rule set built by BuildIntakeEligibilityConfig. Business rules are inactive when null.
- `Message`: `MailMessage` (required) - MailMessage to evaluate. SkipReason and IsTriaged are set on the object in place.

sections.title: Outputs
sections.body:
- `Payload`: `EligibilityResult` - Typed eligibility result: IsEligible, SkipReason, SenderDomain, SubjectSignal, AttachmentProfile, RulesFired.
- `IsEligible`: `bool`
- `RejectionReasons`: `List<string>` - All rule codes that failed (empty when eligible).

activities.name: GetMessages
activities.summary: Lists messages from a mail folder via Microsoft Graph. Optionally applies eligibility rules with fill-to-target pagination, and expands extensions + attachment metadata. Returns up to Config.Mail.GetCount items.

sections.body:
- `Config`: `M365Config` (required)
- `EligibilityRules`: `IntakeEligibilityConfig` - Optional. When set, drives Level-1 Graph $filter + Level-2 client-side attachment filtering and fill-to-target pagination. Null = single page, no filtering.
